title: The House I Live In Official Trailer #1 (2012) Drugs Documentary Movie HD
summary: Official trailer for Eugene Jarecki's 2012 documentary The House I Live In, an investigative look at America's war on drugs and its effect on the criminal justice system. It won the Grand Jury Prize at Sundance.
why: HN commenters recommend the film itself as an eye-opening account of how drug laws drove mass incarceration and militarized policing.

quote.text: a fantastic documentary about the US drug war/justice system. Go watch it now.
